faculty_decisions.FD-PILOT-01: Ratify GI_MANAGEMENT_TRACE_V1 as RATIFIED_FOR_CONTROLLED_DEVELOPMENT_PILOT_PREPARATION; NOT clinical validation, production approval or resident deployment yet.
faculty_decisions.FD-PILOT-02: The ten reviewed management paths establish sufficient development evidence that the end-to-end Management Trace construct is causally and educationally coherent. Do NOT reopen GI pressure calibration, common-tone calibration, norepinephrine manual-rate calibration, parser/order safety or management-path calibration unless a material contradiction appears during pilot preparation or actual use.
faculty_decisions.FD-PILOT-03: Preserve the reviewed management meanings as FACULTY INTERPRETATIONS: reasonable, temporizing, incomplete, clearly nonbeneficial. Do NOT automatically convert them into resident scores. Do NOT hard-code them as correctness labels.
faculty_decisions.FD-PILOT-04: H1 remains open: the live engine can perform hemostasis after GI consultation. For the pilot-preparation package: BLOCK or BOUND the encounter before unreviewed definitive hemostasis. Do NOT silently allow an unreviewed source-control trajectory.
faculty_decisions.FD-PILOT-05: H2 remains open: mental status under norepinephrine is nonauthoritative. Do NOT expose tone-driven or pressure-derived consciousness as validated feedback. Resident-visible mental status must be clearly classified as legacy / nonauthoritative or omitted where necessary to avoid misleading feedback.
faculty_decisions.FD-PILOT-06: Current pilot scope: GI hemorrhagic shock only. Do NOT include pump-limited vasopressor cases, pulmonary edema vasopressor use, ACS vasopressor use, other vasopressors, target-based norepinephrine titration, weight-based norepinephrine dosing.
faculty_decisions.FD-PILOT-07: Primary pilot question: can a resident manage a synthetic hemorrhagic-shock encounter, make sequential decisions, observe coherent consequences, and receive a Management Trace that is useful for reflection without exposing internal model variables or unsafe interpretations?
faculty_decisions.FD-PILOT-08: The pilot must remain faculty-supervised, development-only, small, reversible and isolated from scoring / summative assessment. No performance consequences.

is_not: a resident score or a correctness label
an approval of any management in a real patient

H1.pilot_handling: BOUNDED: a request for definitive control is recorded and not carried out, and the encounter ends at the development boundary (gi_pilot)

reopen_only_if: a material contradiction appears during pilot preparation or actual use
